name: LASER-bench
description: A benchmark built around LASER-style multilingual sentence embeddings to evaluate cross-lingual semantic similarity and retrieval. It measures how well embeddings align semantically across languages using tasks such as bitext retrieval and sentence-level similarity comparisons. The benchmark is intended to assess embedding quality for multilingual applications rather than downstream generation.
evaluation_method: retrieval and correlation metrics (Recall@K for retrieval tasks; correlation metrics such as Spearman/Pearson for similarity)
reputation: Used in multilingual embedding and retrieval research; recognized by researchers working on cross-lingual representations but not a dominant community-wide standard.
